result.title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
result.summary: Post-training low-rank compression of neural networks must not only approximate the original weights but also preserve the model's input-output behavior. Recent output-aware methods measure the compression error beyond the compressed layer, at the model output, weighting logit changes by the observed next token or by the model's predicted probabilities. We propose Complete-SVD, a method for large language models that minimizes the $L_2$ distance between the logits of the original and compressed models, weighting all logit changes equally. Linearizing the network around the original weights, together with a Kronecker-factored approximation, reduces this objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution. Its output-side factor is intractable to compute; we estimate it without bias from random probes, at a cost of $K$ backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. At matched settings with uniform ranks and WikiText-2 calibration, Complete-SVD achieves the lowest C4 and PTB perplexity in every setting, and at ratio 0.7 under LEMS rank allocation. Replacing the $L_2$ distance by the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL-SVD), with the same estimation framework, lowers calibration perplexity in most settings and raises downstream accuracy, but raises cross-corpus perplexity. Complete-SVD also improves IFEval instruction-following accuracy over the strongest prior output-aware methods throughout.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Complete-SVD：对原始与压缩模型 logits 的 L2 距离做线性化与 Kronecker 分解近似，化为带闭式解的加权 SVD，并用随机探针无偏估计输出侧因子，用于 LLM 低秩压缩。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作关注权重低秩近似与困惑度、指令跟随等压缩指标，未涉及视觉信息保留、latent 推理状态生成或推理期证据使用，也无可供核查的状态或决策类方法线索。
